description.value:
Great Breakthrough. You exhale a torrent of wind that flattens everything before it in a 30-foot cone. Creatures take 3d8 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save. Failure also pushes the creature 10 feet away from you, and critical failure additionally knocks them prone.

The cone is powerful enough to clear smoke, mist, or fog effects of equal or lower rank, and to topple any unattended object of Light Bulk or less.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d8.
